artifacts.title: The Binary Totient Series: a complete working record of Erdős Problem 249
artifacts.claim_scope: Full working record for Erdős Problem 249: checked premises, finite certificates, closed routes, surviving obligations, evidence bands, and Lean coordinates. The problem remains open.

artifacts.title: Reciprocal Mersenne Subseries: a complete working record of Erdős Problem 257
artifacts.claim_scope: Full working record for Erdős Problem 257: checked premises, finite computations, equivalent and weaker routes, surviving obligations, evidence bands, and Lean coordinates. The record includes the finite-support obstruction at 1/21 and exact primitive 2p+3q rank-cone coverage and multiplicity facts, while keeping the missing Booleanisation step explicit. The universal, half-value, and 1/21 membership questions remain open.

artifacts.title: Exact Ranks for the Dyadic Sections of Euler’s Totient
artifacts.claim_scope: Standalone exposition of Erdős Problem 249, ordered unconditional results first: the exact level-e dyadic totient section rank 2^e+1 and the resulting infinite-dimensionality, the explicit denominator exclusion (whose Farey provenance is stated rather than implied), the phi*mu Lambert weight that separates #249 from the settled omega/Omega/tau series, and two scoped method no-go theorems. Every remaining obligation is named and the problem remains open.

artifacts.title: Forced Structure in Mersenne Subseries
artifacts.claim_scope: Standalone exposition of Erdős Problem 257 led by exact finite-period noncollapse, necessary structure for any rational-valued infinite support, and achievement-set geometry. Duverney–Tachiya's full-text Corollary 1.2 and Example 1.1 settle the squarefree support at base 2, but not at bases b≥3; the manuscript separately proves that two divisibility-first certificate engines miss this settled value and that irrationality is invariant under finite support changes via checked prefix/tail lemmas. It also records that no finite rank-at-least-two support sums to 1/21 and that the associated primitive 2p+3q cone covers every rank from eleven while retaining recurrent multiplicities; achievement-set membership and Booleanisation remain open. Tao–Teräväinen prove the prime-support case at base 2; broader base and prime-power extensions are remarks rather than proved theorems there. Universal Erdős #257 and the half-value test remain open.

artifacts.title: Excluding the Bounded Negative Part
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos243 modules. Lean checks that finite normalised negative centred-defect mass, together with the exact tail dynamics, positivity, and normalised vanishing, forces eventual Sylvester recurrence. The analytic bridge and the unbounded divergent-mass branch remain open; Erdős Problem 243 remains open.

artifacts.title: The Prime-Gap Equivalence and the Integral-Shift Frontier
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos251 module. Lean checks the infinite prime/gap equivalence conditional on summability, denominator collapse for rational dyadic recurrences, unboundedness and non-eventual-periodicity of the actual prime gaps, and the exact local implication from cofinally recurring adjacent small-mismatch tail shifts to failure of eventual integrality. The prime-number-theorem summability and concrete prime-gap-tail instantiation are paper proofs; no theorem supplies the required cofinal adjacent small-mismatch pairs, and Erdős Problem 251 remains open.

artifacts.title: The Three-Prime Running Least Common Multiple
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos269 modules. Lean checks the exact dyadic block radix alphabet {2,6,10,30}, canonical least-positive-residue arithmetic, smooth-factor absorption, conditional common-factor cancellation, and the complete implication from denominator-dependent CofinalLocalWindowEscape to extinction of a bounded positive reduced carry. An integer-only checker supplies finite exact evidence for 106,666 denominator/start pairs, but the actual block-digit carry instantiation—including divisibility of the carry by the absorbed smooth denominator factor—and the cofinal escape producer are not proved; Erdős Problem 269 remains open.

artifacts.title: Rational Bases and the Integer-Base Argument
artifacts.claim_scope: Exposition of the ErdosProblems.Erdos1049 modules. Lean checks that rowwise contents scale the Padé error, exterior determinant, and absolute determinant height by exactly the same factors; under unit endpoint hypotheses a common specialised multiplier contains neither two nor three. It also checks the homogeneous endpoint obstruction, the negative scalar margin implication at three halves, the exact four-jet target cardinality, and the sufficient collision threshold n >= 4R+2S for positive R. The primary Zudilin theorem remains integer-base and external; a sufficiently large primitive non-collapsed family, surviving local gain after primitive normalisation, and a collision with nonzero polynomial pair and remainder are not proved. Erdős Problem 1049 remains open.
